values.description: Default bearer token after Login, Register User, or Register Officer. Used by user/manager requests and general protected routes. Officer Tier C workflows use officer_hub_active_token instead so this can be overwritten by other logins.

Officer bearer token with an active shared shift. Set by Auth / Login Officer at Hub or Start Shift (after remote login). Required for Tier C officer writes (assign-self, resolutions, community post writes, etc.).
Canonical officer bearer token for Tier B routes (notifications, browse). Set by any officer login or registration.
Officer bearer token without relying on access_token (e.g. after Auth / Login Officer Remote or Register Officer). Use for Tier B browse smoke tests and Start Shift when no active shift.
Bearer token for an active main manager (is_main_manager=true). Set by Auth / Login as Main Manager. Required for Managers folder and department mutations.

Bearer token for an ordinary manager (is_main_manager=false). Set manually after Auth / Login with a non-main manager account. Use to test officer district assignment and to verify category/district/department mutations return 403 without main-manager privileges.
Bearer token for a deactivated actor (is_active=false). Copy from a pre-deactivation login, then deactivate the actor in the database. Used by Auth / Inactive Actor smoke requests.
Target ordinary manager ID for PATCH/DELETE manager routes. Overwritten when Create Manager succeeds.
Target department ID for update, deactivate (PATCH is_active), and delete examples.
